pages.text: $(l)Flower Shield$() surrounds you in a protective petal barrier that absorbs incoming damage.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 10$(br)$(l)Type:$() Defense$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 30,000 + 15,000/level$(br2)The shield has its own HP pool (base 20 + 5/level). When the shield breaks, it shatters with a glass-break effect. Enhanced by the Rune of Earth catalyst (+30% shield strength).

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Rare Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Flower Shield$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
